summary: Real-time sync uses webhooks to notify connectors when source data is created, updated, or deleted, and is in Public Preview for Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft SharePoint Online, and ServiceNow.

evidence_snippets: Overrun The data sync is ongoing, but has taken longer than expected and continues to run at the time that the next run is scheduled.
For each sync run in the table, you can expand the row by clicking the date and time under Connector run .
Each sync run is listed, with the following fields: Connector run : the date and time of the sync run.
